preregistration_rule: These acceptance criteria are frozen BEFORE any reviewer R3 labels are produced (C-R6). They are IDENTICAL for every ML-trained category and CANNOT be changed, relaxed or reinterpreted on the basis of R3 results. Any change requires a new owner decision and a new revision id; the rejected/prior version is preserved.

C1.metric: Wilson 95% upper bound of adjudicated INCORRECT

C2.metric: Wilson 95% upper bound of adjudicated UNCERTAIN+INCORRECT

coverage.metric: share of gate-relevant items reviewed and resolved

unresolved_gate_relevant.metric: count of UNRESOLVED/MISSING/FURTHER_REVIEW gate-relevant items at PASS

acceptance_criteria.model_agreement: DIAGNOSTIC ONLY — never independent ground-truth validation
acceptance_criteria.post_hoc_small_n_exception: NONE (CRLF n=22 and XPath n=31 held to the same thresholds)

denominators.per_category_wilson_denominator: the category's size in the original 453-record stratified frame
denominators.no_duplicate_counting: each physical record is counted once per metric; the 16 shared records carry one R3 label serving both coverage and disagreement resolution
denominators.no_independent_denominator_for_targeted_: the 33 gate-relevant disagreements are already inside the 453 frame; they resolve labels in place and DO NOT create a separate Wilson denominator

feasibility_reference_non_binding.note: Illustrative Wilson-95 upper feasibility at the real n; NOT a threshold change. Bounds an AI-adjudicated classification rate, not ground-truth error.

adjudication_policy.step1_agreement: a1 = a2 keeps that label (R3 minority never overrides a concordant pair)
adjudication_policy.step2_vp_rule: vp_split_to_probably_correct/v1 (owner-approved) resolves VERIFIABLE vs PROBABLY_CORRECT splits
adjudication_policy.step3_majority: for a1 != a2, strict majority of {a1,a2,R3} ONLY when all three valid labels exist
adjudication_policy.step4_unresolved: three-way disagreement OR any missing required vote -> UNRESOLVED -> evidence-based owner decision; never automatic INCORRECT
adjudication_policy.missing_label_handling: a missing/unparseable reviewer label is a non-vote; if it leaves no majority the item is UNRESOLVED; never scored as correct or incorrect
adjudication_policy.owner_adjudication: requires documented evidence; permits procedural disposition, exclusion or commissioning further review; CANNOT manufacture ground truth

unresolved_case_handling: any UNRESOLVED/MISSING/FURTHER_REVIEW gate-relevant item blocks category acceptance (status INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE); it is never scored as INCORRECT to force a FAIL

r3_diagnostics.r3_incorrect_share: diagnostic only; never reported as a human/ground-truth error rate
r3_diagnostics.r3_vs_a1a2_only_resolved_reference: diagnostic only; computed against the a1/a2-only resolved reference (excluding R3's own vote); unresolved disagreements are not scored without a prior independent reference

status_semantics.VERIFIED: per-payload label_status (D59), independently established; NEVER conferred by the audit or by model consensus
status_semantics.AI_AUDITED: provenance tag: audited with LLM reviewers, no independent human review
status_semantics.PASS_AI_AUDITED: category eligible for V5 TRAIN; strictly weaker than human-validated; confers no VERIFIED
status_semantics.INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE: coverage/resolution not met; category not supported

category_dispositions_at_freeze.Server Side Request Forgery: NOT SUPPORTED — recorded C1 failure (21/50 concordant INCORRECT, Wilson-95 upper ~55.8%, 0 of the 33); excluded from the eligible V5 dataset pending a separately approved correction and re-audit (C-R6: one re-audit after a documented filter change, new seed)
category_dispositions_at_freeze.all_other_categories: PENDING audit (no PASS; R3 not run)

limitations: No trusted independent human reference labels exist for the post-filter pool; the TRUE annotator error rate cannot be established.

Deterministic/stratified sampling alone does not prove statistical representativeness; Wilson bounds describe the adjudicated audit sample under the stated sampling assumptions, not ground-truth error.
AI-only adjudication: model agreement, including R3, is diagnostic and never independent validation.
This is a disclosed post-hoc methodological deviation; no report may describe AI-assisted review as human validation.
FINAL V5 training remains BLOCKED until separately authorized and all training-readiness controls pass.
immutability_note: The SHA-256 of this file is recorded in reports/v5/postfilter-audit/preregistration/SHA256SUMS and in D67. R3 must be run only after this file is committed by the owner; the audit code must read these frozen criteria, not recompute them.
